rules.advice: The client closed the connection before the response was written (a closed tab, a timeout on the client side); not a server failure.

match.message: Обрыв канала|Broken pipe|Connection reset by peer

rules.advice: The client closed the connection before the response was written; not a server failure.
A client calls an endpoint that does not exist (often a frontend polling a path an older build had); not a failure of this service, but frequent ones crowd the sample.

match.message: Invalid character found in the request target|Error parsing HTTP request header|Character decoding failed

rules.advice: Tomcat rejected a malformed request (an unencoded URL from a client or a scanner); not a failure of this service.
rules.filter: !~ "Invalid character found in the request target|Error parsing HTTP request header|Character decoding failed"

match.message: Не удалось отправить в СМЭВ запрос "(?<recipient>[^"]+)"

rules.subject: SMEV
rules.advice: The request to ${recipient} through SMEV failed on the transport: the SMEV adapter of the stand or the recipient is unavailable. Retry later; the card goes to ERROR_SENDING meanwhile.

rules.subject: SMEV
rules.advice: The SMEV transport answered with an HTTP error: the SMEV adapter of the stand or the recipient is unavailable. Retry later.

match.message: (?i)Connection is not available|Connection to \S+ refused|connection attempt failed|terminating connection|the database system is (starting up|shutting down)|не удалось подключиться

rules.subject: PostgreSQL
rules.advice: The service could not get a database connection: PostgreSQL is down or restarting, or the Hikari pool is exhausted by long transactions.

rules.subject: table ${table}
rules.advice: Table ${table} does not exist in the schema this service uses: its migrations did not run against this database, or the service points to the wrong schema.

rules.subject: Redis
rules.advice: Redis did not answer in time: it is down, restarting or overloaded; sessions and caches of this service are affected.

rules.subject: Kafka
rules.advice: The Kafka client of this service reports a broker or network problem.

rules.subject: Schema Registry
rules.advice: The Avro schema lookup failed: Schema Registry is unavailable or the subject is not registered.

rules.subject: ${host}
rules.advice: The call to ${host} did not get an answer (connection refused or timed out): that service is down or restarting.

rules.subject: auth (sec, Keycloak)
rules.advice: Another service rejected this service's call with 401: its service token or Keycloak client is wrong, or sec is down.

match.message: Schema "(?<schema>[^"]+)" has version (?<version>[\d.]+), but no migration could be resolved

rules.subject: schema ${schema}
rules.advice: The service stops at start-up: schema ${schema} is at version ${version}, newer than the migrations of this build (another branch or PR stand migrated the shared database). Deploy a matching build or clean the extra migrations.
The Spring context failed to start; the root cause above says which bean or setting.
The service did not start; read the lines around this one with getLogContext for the reason Spring Boot prints.

match.message: Could not find ClientRegistration with id '(?<client>[^']+)'

rules.subject: OAuth2 client ${client}
rules.advice: The OAuth2 client registration '${client}' is missing from this service's configuration (spring.security.oauth2.client.registration.${client}).

match.message: Не найдена доступная задача с классом (?<task>[\w.$]+)

rules.subject: task worker
rules.advice: The service the scheduler sent the task to has no worker for ${task}: the task is routed to the wrong service, or the worker bean is not loaded there.
